Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

09:44 AM

Yes. In simple terms:

Handheld: best for very small, specific areas and easy to move around. The HELIOS FOCUS is the most portable option.
Targeted panel: best for one body area at a time, like a knee, shoulder, or lower back. The HELIOS 2 300W is the entry point here.
Half-body panel: a middle ground with more coverage per session. The HELIOS 2 600W suits people who want more than spot treatment without going full size.
Full-body panel: best if you want broad coverage in one session. The HELIOS 2 1000W gives full-body reach in a slimmer format, while the 1500W is the largest option with even more coverage.

All HELIOS panels come with free next day shipping where available and a 5 year warranty. The handheld FOCUS has a 1 year warranty.
